title: Generative AI-Driven Full-Process Computer-Aided Design
summary: AInnovation completed a ChatCAD MVP integrated with Bentley software. Faster design and shorter product-development cycles remain intended benefits.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: AInnovation completed a ChatCAD MVP integrated with Bentley software. Faster design and shorter product-development cycles remain intended benefits. MVP complete / commercial rollout planned.
purpose: Help designers create and revise industrial designs through generative AI.

ratings.reason: Design businesses are intended to improve design efficiency and product development.
Designers are intended to use natural-language tools more easily; no individual capability outcome is recorded.

ai_role.statement: The chapter describes this system as supporting the stated purpose. Its causal contribution to the benefit has not been separately assessed.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 6: Generative AI-Driven Full-Process Computer-Aided Design

produced_by: Causal conditions are not established separately in the extracted chapter.
must_hold: Integration with CAD software and relevant design data

headline: ChatCAD brings natural-language assistance to design

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
